neighbours.label: The slot that opens a named technical mechanism or command: 'sudo' starting a shell command line, and the article right before a named firing mechanism or landing-gear type (either a flintlock, uses a tricycle undercarriage); not 'sudo' mentioned in prose and not an article before an ordinary object
fire:
Check that the daemon is installed, then reload it:
sudo systemctl reload sshd

To install the compiler on Ubuntu, enter:
sudo apt install build-essential

Edit the hosts file with root rights:
sudo nano /etc/hosts

If the disk is not mounted yet, mount it manually:
sudo mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt/data
Most pistols of the period were fired by either a percussion cap or a wheellock.
The Spitfire used a conventional tailwheel undercarriage that retracted outward.
Early colonial militias were usually armed with a flintlock musket and a bayonet.
The bomber relied on a nosewheel undercarriage to improve visibility on landing.
quiet:
Check that the daemon is installed, then reload it:
systemctl reload sshd
On Ubuntu you need sudo rights before you can install the compiler.

Edit the hosts file with a text editor:
nano /etc/hosts
Ask the administrator, who can use sudo to mount the disk for you.
Most pistols of the period were carried in a leather holster on the belt.
The Spitfire used a distinctive elliptical wing that gave it a clean silhouette.
Early colonial militias were usually supplied with a wool coat and a blanket.
The bomber relied on a large crew to handle navigation and gunnery.
